business_objective: Synthesize and govern full department strategy, creative assets, and measurement plans; resolve strategic trade-offs; establish priority roadmap; enforce strict epistemic and approval boundaries.
validated_intelligence_findings: Ollama executes open-weight models locally via CLI and REST API daemon on localhost:11434 (EVID-WEB-893338BD, EVID-WEB-2BAE59D7).
Hardware boundaries: 7B Q4 models require ~4-5GB VRAM, 14B models require ~8-10GB; exceeding GPU VRAM triggers CPU fallback latency (EVID-WEB-2BAE59D7, CONF-40334167).
Multi-OS availability across macOS, Linux, and Windows binary installers (EVID-WEB-893338BD).
Developer community setup friction centered on manual C++ compilation (EVID-FORUM-F119C750).

strategy_recommendations.title: Local Developer Runtime Positioning Architecture
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Position Ollama as a streamlined CLI and localhost REST API runtime layer for local open-weight model execution across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Provides developer convenience over manual C++ inference dependencies (llama.cpp/CUDA) and predictable, zero-per-token local execution.
assumptions: Target developers value local execution and predictable costs over cloud-managed API simplicity.
uncertainties: Paid enterprise conversion and telemetry install base remain unmeasured (TRANSACTION_DATA = MISSING).
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Reconsider if cloud API token prices fall so low that local runtime maintenance is economically non-compelling.

strategy_recommendations.title: Developer Setup Friction Reduction Wedge
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Position Ollama as a streamlined local developer setup wedge for running open-weight models without manual compilation.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Sampled Hacker News developer discussions (N=25) confirm utility of automated CUDA setup and model abstraction.
assumptions: Automated setup is a primary decision factor for local developers.
uncertainties: Representative ecosystem-wide developer satisfaction remains unmeasured (REPRESENTATIVE_DEVELOPER_RECEPTION_DATA = MISSING).
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: A/B test onboarding copy clarity against setup-related GitHub issue volume.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Halt positioning if automated setup friction exceeds manual llama.cpp compilation.

strategy_recommendations.title: Localhost REST API Promotion
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Promote the localhost REST API service (running on port 11434) as a drop-in integration layer for local workflow automation and script integration.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Verified in technical documentation and developer community samples.
assumptions: Developers desire local HTTP/REST API endpoints rather than CLI-only subprocess execution.
uncertainties: Concurrency scaling and multi-model routing constraints on local hardware.
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: Track local API call activation velocity in sample developer workflows.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Halt promotion if API endpoint compatibility issues cause widespread integration failures.

strategy_recommendations.title: Transparent Model-to-Hardware VRAM Boundary Guidance
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Provide upfront, explicit hardware guidance (e.g., 4-5GB VRAM for 7B Q4, 8-10GB for 14B) to pre-empt CPU fallback latency disappointment.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Verified in technical documentation that low VRAM triggers slow CPU inference fallback.
assumptions: Upfront hardware transparency preserves developer trust and reduces early churn.
uncertainties: Exact hardware distribution among active user base is unknown (PRIVATE_TELEMETRY_DATA = MISSING).
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: Compare onboarding retention between users seeing VRAM sizing tools vs generic download pages.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Maintain permanently as core technical transparency guardrail.

strategy_recommendations.title: Demand Creation Technical Architecture Guides
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Publish technical architecture teardowns and workflow automation guides showing how local inference addresses compliance and data sovereignty requirements.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: First-party copy emphasizes offline execution and data privacy.
assumptions: Engineering teams in regulated domains seek offline local inference architectures.
uncertainties: Enterprise procurement cycles and decision-maker roles remain unvalidated.
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: Engagement velocity and inbound technical inquiries generated from architecture teardowns.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Pivot content strategy if compliance content fails to drive technical engagement.

strategy_recommendations.title: Hypothesized Demand Capture via Technical Search
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Hypothesize technical search as a qualified developer acquisition channel, targeting queries like 'run llama locally' and 'offline llm runner' subject to keyword demand validation.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Search discovery identified active technical queries; demand magnitude requires empirical test.
assumptions: Sufficient commercial and technical search volume exists for local model runners.
uncertainties: Organic search impression-to-install conversion rate is unmeasured.
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: Execute controlled search capture experiment to measure search intent and install rate.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: De-prioritize organic search if search traffic fails to generate active CLI sessions.

strategy_recommendations.title: Trade-off: Do NOT Market as Production Cluster Replacement
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Explicitly avoid positioning Ollama as an enterprise high-throughput production cluster replacement without clarifying host VRAM prerequisites.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Physical hardware boundaries dictate inference throughput; misleading claims damage credibility.
assumptions: Brand credibility with technical developers requires strict adherence to physical compute realities.
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: Monitor community sentiment and technical issue reports regarding performance expectations.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Maintain permanently as core positioning constraint.

strategy_recommendations.title: Trade-off: Do NOT Run Broad Consumer Ad Spend
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Explicitly avoid broad consumer paid ad campaigns across non-technical social channels.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Current evidence is strongly developer-oriented and does not establish broad consumer-market fit.
assumptions: Non-technical consumers lack motivation or workflow needs for local terminal/API model execution.
uncertainties: Potential consumer desktop GUI adoption remains unmeasured.
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: Audit CAC against developer conversion baselines before allocating non-developer ad budget.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Re-evaluate only if an end-consumer GUI app is released with verified consumer demand.

strategy_recommendations.title: Trade-off: Do NOT Claim Proprietary AI Model Benchmarks
strategy_recommendations.recommendation: Explicitly avoid claiming proprietary model benchmark leadership; maintain focus strictly on runtime orchestration, developer UX, and hardware boundary transparency.
strategy_recommendations.rationale: Ollama orchestrates open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) rather than training proprietary weights.
assumptions: Developers evaluate Ollama on orchestration utility, not model weight architecture.
strategy_recommendations.validation_test: Track developer brand perception as neutral model orchestrator.
strategy_recommendations.stop_or_reconsider_condition: Maintain permanently as core brand distinction.

experiment_portfolio.title: Creative Hook Mechanism Test: Setup Friction vs REST API Specificity
experiment_portfolio.question: Does framing local LLM adoption around setup friction (VAR-A) generate higher initial developer retention than REST API specificity (VAR-B)?
experiment_portfolio.hypothesis: Friction-focused hook (VAR-A) outperforms API specificity (VAR-B) in initial 3-second developer hook retention.
experiment_portfolio.control: VAR-B (REST API daemon specificity hook: 'Did you know Ollama runs on port 11434?')
experiment_portfolio.treatment: VAR-A (Friction recognition hook: 'Tired of configuring CUDA drivers?')
experiment_portfolio.target_segment: Software developers on macOS, Linux, and Windows browsing technical content
guardrails: Bounce Rate must not increase by > 10%
experiment_portfolio.randomization_or_assignment: 50/50 randomized delivery across identical audience cohorts
experiment_portfolio.sample_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires baseline rate, MDE, and statistical power parameters)
experiment_portfolio.duration_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires traffic volume, MDE, variance, conversion lag, and business cycle calculation)
experiment_portfolio.stop_condition: Halt early if treatment exhibits severe anomaly (>50% bounce increase) or tracking failure
experiment_portfolio.analysis_method: Two-sample proportion test with 95% confidence intervals; INCONCLUSIVE supported if power is inadequate
experiment_portfolio.limitations: Does not measure local CLI execution after download.
experiment_portfolio.next_decision: If VAR-A wins, scale friction-first creative across technical channels; if inconclusive, maintain balanced distribution.

experiment_portfolio.title: Hardware Qualification CTA Test: VRAM Tool vs Direct Download
experiment_portfolio.question: Does offering upfront model-to-VRAM hardware qualification (VAR-C) reduce early onboarding drop-off compared to direct binary download CTA?
experiment_portfolio.hypothesis: Providing an upfront model-to-VRAM compatibility guide pre-qualifies developers and improves downstream CLI setup completion.
experiment_portfolio.control: Direct 'Download Ollama' CTA on landing page hero
experiment_portfolio.treatment: Interactive 'Check Model Hardware Compatibility Chart' CTA on landing page hero
experiment_portfolio.target_segment: Developers arriving on landing page with bounded GPU VRAM
guardrails: Total initiated downloads must not decrease significantly
experiment_portfolio.randomization_or_assignment: Server-side A/B split on landing page hero module
experiment_portfolio.sample_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires baseline rate, MDE, and statistical power parameters)
experiment_portfolio.duration_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires traffic volume, MDE, variance, conversion lag, and business cycle calculation)
experiment_portfolio.stop_condition: Halt if treatment reduces total download intent by > 20%
experiment_portfolio.analysis_method: Relative risk comparison and bootstrap confidence intervals
experiment_portfolio.limitations: Downstream setup completion requires opt-in verification or follow-up feedback telemetry.
experiment_portfolio.next_decision: If VRAM qualification improves downstream activation, make hardware sizing the standard onboarding step.

experiment_portfolio.title: Search Intent Validation Test: Technical Keyword Demand Capture
experiment_portfolio.question: Does commercial intent exist for technical search queries ('run llama locally', 'offline llm runner')?
experiment_portfolio.hypothesis: Developers searching for local model execution keywords have high downstream documentation and installation intent.
experiment_portfolio.treatment: Targeted search capture on exact-match technical developer queries
experiment_portfolio.target_segment: High-intent developers searching technical local LLM queries
guardrails: Maintain strict negative keyword list to prevent consumer/gaming traffic leakage
experiment_portfolio.randomization_or_assignment: Search ad group geographic holdout or time-series switchback test
experiment_portfolio.sample_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires baseline rate, MDE, and statistical power parameters)
experiment_portfolio.duration_requirement: TO_BE_DETERMINED (Requires traffic volume, MDE, variance, conversion lag, and business cycle calculation)
experiment_portfolio.stop_condition: Halt if search queries demonstrate zero download intent after initial sample threshold
experiment_portfolio.analysis_method: Pre/post quasi-experimental lift analysis against non-search control cohorts
experiment_portfolio.limitations: Search engine keyword volume estimates may fluctuate.
experiment_portfolio.next_decision: If search demonstrates qualified intent, transition CHAN-TECH-SEARCH from HYPOTHESIS to PRIMARY channel.
